# GUI Interface Description

## Top Bar

- **Left Side:**
  - "Activities" button
  - "Files" application icon with a context menu open

- **Center:**
  - Date and time: "Oct 22 21:35"
  - Notification bell icon

- **Right Side:**
  - System status icons including:
    - Network connectivity icon
    - Sound/volume control icon
    - Power button icon

## Left Dock (Application Launcher)

- **Top to Bottom:**
  - Google Chrome icon
  - Thunderbird email client icon
  - Visual Studio Code icon
  - VLC media player icon
  - LibreOffice Writer icon
  - LibreOffice Calc icon
  - LibreOffice Impress icon
  - GIMP image editor icon
  - File manager icon (folder)
  - Ubuntu Software icon (orange shopping bag)
  - Help icon (blue circle with question mark)
  - Trash icon (green recycle bin)
  - Application grid icon (nine dots)

## Context Menu (Files Application)

- **Menu Items:**
  - "New Window"
  - "Quit"

## File Manager Window

- **Title Bar:**
  - Navigation: "Home / Downloads"
  - Three-dot menu button
  - Search icon
  - View options button (grid icon with dropdown)
  - Window control buttons: Minimize, Maximize, Close

- **Left Sidebar (Navigation Panel):**
  - "Recent" (with clock icon)
  - "Starred" (with star icon)
  - "Home" (with house icon)
  - "Desktop" (with folder icon)
  - "Documents" (with document icon)
  - "Downloads" (with download icon, highlighted in gray)
  - "Music" (with music note icon)
  - "Pictures" (with image icon)
  - "Videos" (with film strip icon)
  - "Trash" (with trash can icon)
  - "Other Locations" (with plus icon)

- **Main Content Area:**
  - Single file displayed: "paywalled_article.html"
  - File icon: HTML document icon with "<>" symbol
  - File name: "paywalled_article.html"

## Desktop Background

- **Visual Design:**
  - Geometric, low-poly style jellyfish
  - Color gradient from deep purple to red-orange
  - Abstract, modern aesthetic

## Desktop Icon

- **Location:** Bottom right corner
- **Icon:** Folder with house symbol
- **Label:** "Home"
